Issue Number: close #20243

Currently, we analyze clustered index and columns by scan the same key-value pairs twice to do different analyze tasks. After this PR, coprocessor only need to scan them once.

issue_context.title: Optimize analyze for clustered index
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Currently analyze clustered index request two full table scan, one is for analyzing the primary key index, another one is for analyzing the columns in the row. This is due to easier to implement.

We need to avoid the extra full table scan by analyzing the primary key index and row columns at the same time.

review_comments: Can we reuse any existing code for mixed analyze logic?
I have extracted a function `buildBaseAnalyzeColumnsExec` to reuse some codes.
